IncidentBot: ALERT: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T14:02Z (deploy-epoch-4321009876) -> elevated 500s on /v1/generate (canary weight 10%). Pager to #eng-sre oncall.
DeployBot: Canary rollout started at 2026-03-17T13:58Z, image: rdnw/inference:v2.7-canary-20260317
Alice: Ack. I'm looking. Linking traces.
Monitoring: 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 8.9% over last 3m. Lat p95 went 120ms -> 2.1s
Ben: Could be kernel change in v2.7. Check kv-cache usage.
Alice: Trying quick traffic tombstone (route weight -> 0) via traffic-router. Running: `POST /router/traffic` payload weight=0 for canary. Router API returning 503.
Carla: If router API is flapping, we can evict canary pods and scale them to 0. Command: `kubectl scale deployment/canary-inference --replicas=0 -n prod`
Alice: doing kubectl scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/canary-inference -n prod --replicas=0`
Alice: kubectl returned: scaled
Monitoring: 5xx rate dropping to 3.1% now
Ben: still worth running verification. I'll reproduce locally against canary image.
Ben: local harness shows memory climb under sequence length 2048, gc thrash.
Alice: plan: manual rollback to previous stable image on inference-main. Update deployment image to rdnw/inference:v2.6.4 and restart.
Carla: prepping patch - `kubectl set image deployment/inference-main inference=rdnw/inference:v2.6.4 -n prod`
Alice: applied. Rolling restart initiated, monitoring events.
DeployBot: rollout status: updated 4/4, available 4/4 -> rollout complete.
Monitoring: error rate back to 0.4% and latency normalized to baseline.
Alice: verification checklist: 1) smoke curl 10x -> expect 200s and p95 < 500ms; 2) search logs for 500s in last 15m; 3) ensure no crashloops on inference-main pods.
Ben: smoke OK. Ran 10 requests, all 200, p95 ~140ms.
Carla: cleared canary pods and removed canary route. traffic-router shows 0% canary.
Alice: customer impact summary: partial failures/timeouts for ~12 minutes, mostly long-prompt batched requests. No evidence of PII exposure. Will file postmortem.
Dan: I'm taking over oncall for the next hour to watch for regressions — Alice handing off. :handshake: 
Alice: Handoff notes: rolled back to v2.6.4, canary pods scaled to 0, suspected root cause = regression in kv-cache under high-seq workloads. Follow-ups: runtime team to add high-seq canary smoke tests and block v2.7 until fix.
IncidentBot: Incident annotated: status=resolved, severity=sev2, duration=12m, incident_id=INC-20260317-4321
Carla: creating PR to block further v2.7 rollouts until tests + fix land. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5123
Ben: adding eviction and kv-cache metrics to canary dashboards.
Dan: closing pager. If anything spikes ping me or reopen. :thumbsup:
